claims.claim: The paper reports neural speech extraction with human feedback.
claims.limitations: Feedback population, mixture construction, target definition, signal metrics, and model scope bound transfer.

claims.claim: The paper reports LinearVC results through the lens of self-supervised feature transformations.
claims.limitations: Feature model, languages, target data, similarity/content metrics, and transform assumptions bound transfer.

claims.claim: The paper reports a study of multilingual/accent robustness and its implications for ASR evaluation.
claims.limitations: Accent labels, languages, speakers, test design, and subgroup denominators bound transfer.
